translated_text: \subsection{{原始表述的 Galerkin 离散化}}\label{sec:primal-galerkin}

source_text: {A simple approach to discretization of the Hodge Laplacian would be the application of Galerkin's method to the primal weak formulation \eqref{eq:hodge-primal-formulation}, i.e., restricting the trial and test functions to some finite dimensional subspace $V_h\subset V^k\cap V_k^*\cap\mathsf H^{k\perp}$. However, this approach suffers from two serious deficiencies, as we shall now show. First, we can anticipate some difficulty working with the condition $V_h\perp\mathsf H^k$, since in many problems, we do not know the space $\mathsf H^k$ explicitly and may not even know its dimension. We will return to this issue in a moment. Second, \emph{the primal approach may have difficulties even when there are no nonvanishing harmonic forms}. The difficulty here is that the space $V^k\cap V_k^*$ is not a standard Sobolev space, and it may be difficult to design a finite element subspace of it with good approximation properties. More precisely, the space may contain vector fields which are too singular to belong to $H^1$ or even to be approximated arbitrarily closely by $H^1$ vector fields. Such singular fields arise as solutions of the Hodge Laplacian on domains with nonconvex corners and in other situations, so this is a serious defect.}
translated_text: {离散化 Hodge Laplacian 的一种简单途径, 是将 Galerkin 方法应用于原始弱表述 \eqref{eq:hodge-primal-formulation}, 即把试探函数和检验函数限制在某个有限维子空间 $V_h\subset V^k\cap V_k^*\cap\mathsf H^{k\perp}$ 中. 但是, 这种途径存在两个严重缺陷, 下面予以说明. 首先, 可以预见, 条件 $V_h\perp\mathsf H^k$ 的处理会有困难, 因为在许多问题中, 我们并不明确知道空间 $\mathsf H^k$, 甚至可能不知道它的维数. 稍后将回到这个问题. 其次, \emph{即使不存在非零调和形式, 原始方法也可能遇到困难}. 这里的困难在于, 空间 $V^k\cap V_k^*$ 不是标准的 Sobolev 空间, 可能难以构造具有良好逼近性质的有限元子空间. 更准确地说, 该空间可能包含过于奇异的向量场, 它们既不属于 $H^1$, 甚至也无法被 $H^1$ 向量场任意精确地逼近. 在具有非凸角点的区域以及其他情形中, 这类奇异场会作为 Hodge Laplacian 的解出现, 因而这是一个严重的缺陷.}

source_text: {In fact, this lack of $H^1$ regularity is typical of solutions of \eqref{eq:primal-galerkin-polygon}. For any such solution, we have $\inf_{v\in H_n^1}\|u-v\|_Y=\delta_u>0$, where $\delta_u$ is the distance of $u$ from the proper closed subspace $H_n^1$. This tells us that if the subspaces $V_h$ are contained in $H_n^1$, then the numerical solution $u_h\in V_h$ cannot converge to $u$. This is the case when $V_h$ is any subspace of $Y$ which consists of piecewise polynomials with respect to some triangulation. Indeed, the condition $V_h\subset H(\operatorname{curl})$ implies that the tangential components of any $v\in V_h$ must be continuous across triangle boundaries, and the fact that $V_h\subset H(\operatorname{div})$ implies that the normal components must be continuous. Thus $V_h$ consists of continuous piecewise polynomial functions, and so $V_h\subset H_n^1$.}
translated_text: {事实上, \eqref{eq:primal-galerkin-polygon} 的解通常就缺乏这种 $H^1$ 正则性. 对任一这样的解, 有 $\inf_{v\in H_n^1}\|u-v\|_Y=\delta_u>0$, 其中 $\delta_u$ 是 $u$ 到真闭子空间 $H_n^1$ 的距离. 这说明, 若子空间 $V_h$ 包含于 $H_n^1$, 则数值解 $u_h\in V_h$ 不可能收敛于 $u$. 当 $V_h$ 是 $Y$ 中由某一剖分上的分片多项式构成的任意子空间时, 情况就是如此. 事实上, 条件 $V_h\subset H(\operatorname{curl})$ 蕴含任意 $v\in V_h$ 的切向分量必须跨三角形边界连续, 而 $V_h\subset H(\operatorname{div})$ 蕴含法向分量必须连续. 因此 $V_h$ 由连续分片多项式函数构成, 从而 $V_h\subset H_n^1$.}

source_text: {In short, \emph{a standard finite element method based on the primal formulation does not generally converge to the solution $u$}. This behavior is illustrated in Figure~\ref{fig:primal-lagrange-failure}, which depicts a numerical analyst's nightmare. The figure on the right shows the numerical solution computed with what would seem to be a natural discretization: the finite element method based on the primal weak formulation, using continuous piecewise linear vector fields as trial functions. The method converges, as the mesh is refined, to what might be taken to be the solution but is, in fact, an altogether different vector field. In three dimensions, the situation is similar but worse, because then $H_n^1$ is a closed subspace of infinite codimension. See \BookCite{34} for an illuminating discussion.}
translated_text: {总之, \emph{基于原始表述的标准有限元方法一般并不收敛于解 $u$}. Figure~\ref{fig:primal-lagrange-failure} 展示了这种行为, 这正是数值分析工作者的噩梦. 右图给出了一种看似自然的离散方法算出的数值解: 基于原始弱表述的有限元方法, 以连续分片线性向量场为试探函数. 随着网格加密, 该方法收敛于一个可能被当作解的向量场, 但实际上它是一个完全不同的向量场. 三维情形类似, 而且更糟, 因为此时 $H_n^1$ 是无限余维的闭子空间. 文献 \BookCite{34} 给出了富有启发性的讨论.}

source_text: {We encountered this problem already in Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction} when we computed the eigenvalues of the vector Laplacian on a polygonal domain with a hole. Because of the reentrant corners, the true eigenfunctions are singular, and the standard finite element method cannot compute them accurately. This results in nonconvergence of the eigenvalues as well, as we saw in the example.}
translated_text: {在 Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction} 计算带孔多边形区域上向量 Laplacian 的特征值时, 我们已经遇到过这一问题. 由于存在凹角, 真正的特征函数是奇异的, 标准有限元方法无法准确计算它们. 正如该例中所见, 这也导致特征值不收敛.}
